overview_description.description: Female Invest is a subscription-based e-learning platform that educates women on personal finance and investing. It currently has members in 60+ countries driven by a goal to close the financial gender gap. Female Invest offers a range of educational resources, including online courses, webinars, workshops, and articles, to help women understand investment principles and strategies. The company operates on a subscription model, offering members exclusive content, tools, and events to enhance their financial knowledge and investment skills.

product.name: Financial Learning Platform Membership
product.description: A subscription-based membership providing access to courses, articles, videos, quizzes, and worksheets on investing, personal finance, and financial wellbeing.

product.name: Trading Simulator
product.description: A virtual trading tool that allows users to practice investment strategies using real market data without risking actual money.

identifier.value: Online Community and Live Q&A Sessions

product.description: A digital community platform where members can ask questions, share knowledge, and participate in live Q&A sessions with financial experts.

product.name: Weekly and Daily Market News Updates
product.description: Regular market news delivered through weekly webinars and daily podcasts to keep members informed about financial markets and economic events.

product.description: A collection of practical articles, quizzes, calculators, and worksheets to help members manage budgets, savings, and investment portfolios.
